basic_details.job_title: NUITL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Chief Financial Officer, Company Secretary Posts
basic_details.short_information: NICDC Uttarakhand Industrial Township Limited (NUITL) is filling 2 contractual posts: 1 Chief Financial Officer (CFO), with a CTC of up to Rs. 25,00,000/- per annum, and 1 Company Secretary (CS), with a CTC of up to Rs. 16,00,000/- per annum. The CFO post needs a bachelor's degree in accounting/finance/public administration, a Chartered Accountant degree and at least 15-20 years of experience. The CS post needs any graduate degree, Fellow or Associate Membership of ICSI and at least 10-15 years of post-qualification experience. Applications in the prescribed format can be sent by Speed Post/Re

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form (Curriculum Vitae for Proposed Professional Staff) given in the advertisement, with a recent colour passport size photograph and your signature at the places marked.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all documents in the sequence listed below, including the updated CV.
Superscribe the envelope "Application for the post of CFO/CS", as applicable.
Send it by Speed Post/Registered Post/Courier to: General Manager, SIIDCUL/ Director, NUITL, SIIDCUL Head Office, Plot No. 29, IT Park, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun – 248013, Uttarakhand.
Or send the application by e-mail to [email protected].
If applying for both posts, use a separate application form for each post, with the subject line "Application for the post ..." written on the envelope.

Applications must reach by 30 November 2026; the application instructions give 5:00 pm as the closing time. The Company takes no responsibility for postal delay, and applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. A valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number are required and must stay active throughout the recruitment.
Application form in the prescribed format with a recent passport size photograph.
Certificates and mark sheets of the required educational/technical qualification.
Experience certificate clearly showing the length and field of experience, and experience certificates for previous employments.
Appointment/joining letter of the current post with a valid identity card/current pay slip, and pay slips for the last three months.
No objection certificate if working in any government department.

content_sections.heading: About NUITL
content_sections.text: NICDC Uttarakhand Industrial Township Limited (NUITL) has been incorporated as a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) for the establishment of the Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) in Khurpia, Uttarakhand, under the Amritsar Kolkata Industrial Corridor (AKIC) Project of the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP). It is a Joint Venture between the Government of Uttarakhand, represented through the State Infrastructure and Industrial Development Corporation of Uttarakhand Limited (SIIDCUL), and the National Industrial Corridor Development and Implementation Trust (NICDIT), a Government of India Trust under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Its registered office is at 29, IIE IT Park, SIIDCUL Building, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand (Tel: 0135-2708100).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NUITL has advertised 2 posts in total, both under the contractual mode of recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Academic qualification: bachelor's degree in accounting/finance/public administration. Professional qualification: Chartered Accountant degree. Added qualifications like MBA will be preferred. Experience: minimum 15-20 years of professional experience in the core finance sector, along with accountability and responsibility for performance including quality, budget, schedule, client and stakeholder management. Academic qualification: any graduate degree. Professional qualification: Fellow or Associate Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Additional qualification: candidates having an LLB degree shall be given preference. Experience: minimum 10-15 years of post-qualification experience with secretarial responsibilities. Post-qualification experience is counted from the date of obtaining membership of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)/Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI). Applications not meeting this criterion will not be considered. Experience gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the post will be taken into consideration for eligibility. Additional weightage may be given to candidates having additional relevant qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: CFO: CTC up to Rs. 25,00,000/- per annum; CS: CTC up to Rs. 16,00,000/- per annum. For both posts, the notice states that the salary, based upon the suitability of the candidate, is negotiable. After selection, the candidate will be fixed on minimum remuneration (where a range is given) as prescribed and will be entitled to a yearly increment. The selected candidate will be on probation for one (01) year, which may be extended for an additional one (01) year based on performance. The appointment is contractual and will not confer any lien or right to regularisation, or any other benefit allowed to regular employees. The qualified incumbents may be taken under the payroll of NICDC Uttarakhand Industrial Township Limited; joining will be on an immediate basis after selection. Appointment is subject to the Service and Conduct Rules of the Company as may be framed from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NUITL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Act as the in-charge of financial operations, control and supervisory head responsible to the company, playing a leadership role in achieving its objectives. Spearhead financial planning and development of the project, including: Preparation of financing plans/corporate plans considering the funding requirement for project activities. Project structuring for implementation in different EPC and PPP modes. Selection of consultants/contractors/concessionaire and monitoring their work and deliverables. Overall management and delivery of the business plan. Meeting all financial reporting obligations for funding for grant aid and contracts, and compliance of the provisions of SSA, SHA and other initiatives. Proactively managing investor relations. Liaison with Central/State Governments, bilateral/multilateral agencies, financial institutions, sponsors and other stakeholders. Driving best practices, standards and codes of practice across project activities. Assisting the MD and Board members with financial reporting at Board meetings and Annual General Meetings. Overseeing the inventory of all fixed assets, including assets purchased with government funds. Developing policies to keep personnel and financial information secure, and ensuring compliance with internal financial and accounting policies. Other duties within the scope of the post. Knowledge and skills listed for the CFO: Strong domain knowledge of Financial Planning, Budgeting, Infrastructure Financing, Multilateral Funding and Capital/Debt Market. Knowledge of accounting practices and standards for the infrastructure sector, and of project structuring, modeling and procurement of large infrastructure projects under PPP and non-PPP modes. Well versed with ERP software like SAP. Organising resources, setting priorities, analytical reasoning, decision-making, interpersonal skills and effective oral and written communication. Administration of the organisation and certifying its compliance with the Companies Act and other statutes and bye-laws. Facilitate Annual General/Extraordinary Meetings, Board meetings and Committee meetings, keep records of proceedings and implement decisions. Prepare agendas, the Directors' report, corporate governance report and Annual Report. Guide Directors in discharging their duties, responsibilities and powers. Custody of the company seal; approve, sign and seal agreements, leases, legal forms and official documents when authorised by the Board. Liaise with regulatory authorities/external agencies and ensure compliance with the Companies Act and Government of India/State guidelines. Handle allotment of shares and maintenance of statutory records and registers. Provide legal input, handle legal matters, advise on agreements and contracts, and supervise activities relating to legal disputes against the Company. Keep abreast of changes in Company Law requirements, and any other tasks assigned by the Management. Legal obligations: filing documents/returns under Companie

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NUITL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must reach by 30 November 2026; the application instructions give 5:00 pm as the closing time. The Company takes no responsibility for postal delay, and applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. A valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number are required and must stay active throughout the recruitment. Application form in the prescribed format with a recent passport size photograph. Matriculation certificate (for age proof). Certificates and mark sheets of the required educational/technical qualification. Experience certificate clearly showing the length and field of experience, and experience certificates for previous employments. Appointment/joining letter of the current post with a valid identity card/current pay slip, and pay slips for the last three months. No objection certificate if working in any government department. Updated CV (absolutely mandatory).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a personal interview of shortlisted candidates, held at Dehradun only. Meeting the requirements does not give a right to be called for interview. The interview date will be informed through e-mail/phone message. Candidates must produce original documents of educational qualification, experience and caste certification, with self-attested photocopies; a candidate whose identity is in doubt, who cannot produce the documents, or whose claims are found incorrect will not be allowed to appear. Shortlisted candidates working in permanent positions in Government establishments, State Government, universities and autonomous bodies will be allowed to appear only with a No Objection Certificate from the present employer. No TA/DA will be paid, and candidates must arrange their own travel and stay.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NUITL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and 1 Company Secretary (CS), both contractual.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The end date of receiving applications is 30 November 2026; applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NUITL CFO post?
faq.answer: A bachelor's degree in accounting/finance/public administration, a Chartered Accountant degree and minimum 15-20 years of professional experience in the core finance sector; MBA will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the NUITL Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Any graduate degree, Fellow or Associate Membership of ICSI and minimum 10-15 years of post-qualification experience with secretarial responsibilities; LLB holders get preference.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not more than 55 years for both posts: as on the date of advertisement for the CFO, and as on the last date of submission of application for the CS.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NUITL CFO and CS posts?
faq.answer: The CTC is up to Rs. 25,00,000/- per annum for the CFO and up to Rs. 16,00,000/- per annum for the CS, negotiable based on suitability.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with self-attested documents by Speed Post/Registered Post/Courier to the SIIDCUL Head Office, Plot No. 29, IT Park, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun – 248013, or by e-mail to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a personal interview of shortlisted candidates, held at Dehradun only, with verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NUITL job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are contractual, with one year of probation extendable by one more year, and the appointment gives no right to regularisation.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate applying for more than one post must use separate application forms, with the post name written on each envelope.
